Proration limits the amount of this series repurchased; the release gives no total principal amount accepted.
Accepts six other note series in full
The offers cover notes due 2027–2032, but the release provides no aggregate debt reduction amount.
Accepted holders receive accrued coupon payment at settlement; no cash outlay is stated.

This is the final execution update for Humana's previously announced debt tender offers, rather than a new operating or earnings disclosure. The total principal amount accepted and the resulting cash use would clarify the transaction's balance-sheet impact.
